upstream.description: Free offline all-in-one file converter for Windows. Converts documents, images, audio and video locally. No uploads, no internet, no dependencies. Built with Python & PySide6. Features dark/light theme, stats dashboard, achievements, and multi-engine fallback.

classification.analysis: File Converter Pro is a free, fully offline Windows desktop app (Python + PySide6) that converts documents, images, audio, and video locally with no uploads, no internet requirement, and no telemetry. It bundles batch conversion, a Windows right-click context-menu integration, folder-watch automation and scheduled tasks running as a background daemon, a stats dashboard, gamified achievements, dark/light theming, and community-contributed language packs, packaged as a signed installer/portable build via PyInstaller and Inno Setup. It targets everyday Windows users who want a private, all-in-one converter instead of browser-based conversion sites; a solo-developer project distributed on GitHub and itch.io.

use_cases.title: Convert documents, images, audio, or video offline on Windows without uploading files
Batch-convert a folder of files via a right-click context menu
Automate recurring conversions with watch-folders and scheduled tasks
